_comment: Stage 7 portfolio policy. Every value carries a provenance tag: FROZEN = existing project configuration or frozen Stage 6.1 contract; PROPOSED = new Stage 7 research assumption (NOT an approved client mandate); TRAIN_CALIBRATED = computed from Train data by the code at run time (value written to the policy manifest, not here).

benchmark.provenance: FROZEN (configs/project.json strategic_weights); verified at run time, never overwritten
benchmark.rebalancing: P0 is reset to the strategic weights at every scheduled weekly decision (same calendar, execution timing and cost model as P1/P2)

constraints.provenance: PROPOSED research assumptions for a moderate-risk multi-asset mandate (project plan: single-ETF caps, equity range, maximum deviation from strategic weights, weekly turnover limit; no numbers were specified)

risk_estimation.provenance: PROPOSED; primary method fixed in advance, alternatives are robustness checks only
risk_estimation.return_units: daily SIMPLE returns exp(log_return) - 1; covariance and expected returns annualized with 252 sessions

equilibrium.description: benchmark-implied (reverse-optimized) excess returns pi_t = (SR_b / sigma_b,t) * Sigma_t w_b; mu_t = rf_t + pi_t
equilibrium.risk_free: trailing mean BIL simple return over 63 sessions, annualized

shrunk_historical.description: mu = (1 - s) * trailing 504-session historical mean + s * equilibrium mu

sensitivity.mean_uncertainty: mu +/- 1 standard error of the trailing historical mean, applied asset by asset

optimizer.objective: posture target: maximize w'mu - (gamma/2) w'Sigma w - (lambda_tracking/2) (w-w_b)'Sigma(w-w_b) subject to the static and risk-budget constraints (no dependence on current holdings)
optimizer.execution_rule: target_then_trade: hold if 0.5*sum|w* - w_pre| <= no_trade_band and w_pre satisfies every hard constraint (a risk-budget deviation inside the band is reported as 'within no-trade band'); else trade to w* if within the turnover cap; else move toward w* along the straight line as far as the cap allows (unmet budget reported). Applied identically to P0 (posture = benchmark), P1 and P2
optimizer.single_step_alternative: maximize the posture objective - lambda_turnover * TO(w, w_pretrade) in one problem; SENSITIVITY ONLY (path dependent: the linear turnover penalty creates a no-trade region that is much wider for re-risking than for de-risking)
optimizer.risk_aversion: gamma_t = SR_b / sigma_b,t (the equilibrium risk aversion, so the unconstrained optimum is the benchmark)

turnover_penalty.formula: lambda_turnover = 2 * cost_rate / holding_horizon_years (traded notional = 2 * one-way turnover)
turnover_penalty.used_in: single-step sensitivity and the stage-2/3 fallback only

fallback_policy: 1. posture target (full problem without turnover term) and the target_then_trade rule

2. if infeasible or not converged: keep every hard constraint (bounds, groups, active-weight limit, turnover cap) and give each risk-budget constraint a non-negative slack with a linear penalty of 10 per unit (turnover-limited transition); report the unmet budget
3. if that also fails: hold the pre-trade weights if they satisfy all hard constraints, else the previous target, else the benchmark; never equal weights

cvar.scenarios: historical daily simple-return vectors of the trailing 504 sessions available at the decision date (no scenario after the decision date)
cvar.secondary_optimizer: linear program (Rockafellar-Uryasev): maximize w'mu - lambda_turnover TO - lambda_tracking_l1 |w - w_b|_1 subject to CVaR_95(w) <= vol_multiplier(d) * CVaR_95(w_b) and all constraints

risk_budget.provenance: PROPOSED mappings, fixed in advance; one Train-calibrated scale (P1 parity)

defensiveness_to_budget.vol_multiplier: 1 - 0.35 d   (target ex-ante volatility = vol_multiplier * benchmark ex-ante volatility at t)

risk_budget.normal_volatility_reference: benchmark ex-ante volatility at t (the project plan's ~10% is only an initial reference and is reported, not imposed)
risk_budget.P2_recovery_rule: RECOVERY keeps the AMBER posture until the frozen state machine returns to GREEN (gradual return; no immediate risk-on)
risk_budget.P1_mapping: d1 = min(1, a * baseline_p_non_normal); a is TRAIN_CALIBRATED so that mean Train d1 = mean Train d2 (equal average defensiveness)

transaction_costs.provenance: PROPOSED illustrative scenarios; no ETF-specific cost data are used
transaction_costs.stress_indicator: trailing 21-session SPY realized volatility above its TRAIN_CALIBRATED Train 90th percentile (known at the decision date)

rebalancing.provenance: FROZEN (project plan: at most one rebalance per week) + Stage 6.1 execution convention
rebalancing.decision_rule: decision on the last trading session of each calendar week (Monday-Sunday) in the split calendar; a final week whose last session cannot be confirmed without the Test calendar is skipped
rebalancing.execution_convention: conservative_close_t_plus_1: signal after close t, execution at close t+1, first holding return t+2
rebalancing.intra_week_signals: recorded (weekly maximum severity) and reported; acted upon only at the next scheduled decision
